## Version and environment

- Interface: Go / CLI / HTTP / web UI / MCP

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest sequence that demonstrates the problem. Include relevant
flags or request shape, expected behavior, actual behavior, and error output.

## Additional context

State whether providers, authentication, custom paths, migrations, or restore
were involved.

Do not attach a real database/backup or paste tokens, provider keys, private
record payloads, full query strings, or other sensitive data. Report security
issues privately as described in `SECURITY.md`.
